feature: Signature card PR 4 (handoff design_handoff_the99_avatar, R1b, calls 8 and 9): a friend's Spares tab with Ask. A tile press opens the spares-only modal with the page's friend first and the wishlist kicker; the count line carries Requested or ✓ Accepted; a ?spare= landing opens the card's modal by itself, or the shared toast when the spare is gone.
note: Needs SOCIAL_FRIENDS_ENABLED on, and a friend of the audit account who shares spares with a pod both are in: FRIEND_ID is their public id; SPARE_CARD the oracle id of a card they offer (best one on the audit account's wishlist, so the kicker shows), SPARE_GONE the oracle id of a card they do not offer. For the captions, the audit account holds an open ask of one of the friend's cards and an accepted ask of another. Built on a scratch branch by a throwaway seed, never committed. Read-only: no Ask is pressed.

rows.label: /friends/[publicId]: the line adds Press one to ask for it., captions carry Requested and ✓ Accepted (call 8)
a tile pressed: the modal, this friend first, kicker on your wishlist, the tile ringed behind (call 8)
a ?spare= landing: the card's modal opens by itself, the tile ringed behind (call 9)
a ?spare= landing on a spare gone since: no modal, the toast (call 9)
